_comment: Stock materials for tools/cad recipes (LLF-69). parts[].material names a key here. densityKgM3 drives manifest massKg/inertia; pbr is passed to cad_export_body.materialsOverride as {name, pbrMetallicRoughness:pbr}. Add a stock here (with a source) before using it in a recipe. 'effective-*' stocks are for parts modelled solid that are really hollow assemblies: their density is the spec-sheet weight divided by the modelled volume.

effective-light-aircraft-airframe.source: LLF-81: class empty weight 767 kg (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cessna_172, 172S) minus prop 15 kg, gear legs 40 kg, tyres 24 kg = 688 kg spread over the 8.728 m^3 modelled solid airframe + control surfaces (skin, structure, engine and cabin are inside the solid envelope)

effective-light-aircraft-controls.source: LLF-81: same effective density as effective-light-aircraft-airframe; red trim finish for the moving surfaces

effective-fixed-pitch-prop.source: LLF-81: ~15 kg 75 in forged-aluminium fixed-pitch prop (assumed typical for the class) / 0.01368 m^3 modelled blade envelope

effective-spring-steel-gear.source: LLF-81: ~40 kg for two main legs + nose strut (assumed) / 0.1014 m^3 modelled leg envelopes

effective-aircraft-tire.source: LLF-81: ~24 kg for 2 x 15x6.00 main + 1 x 5.00-5 nose wheel/tyre assemblies (assumed) / 0.04287 m^3 modelled discs

a380-diecast-grey.source: A380 die-casting alloy 2.71 g/cc (NADCA); grey powder-coat finish

effective-cobra-head-luminaire.source: 50 lb (22.7 kg) cobra-head luminaire (shineretrofits 20 ft pole listing) / 0.02912 m^3 modelled housing envelope

ductile-iron-red.source: ASTM A536 ductile iron 7.1 g/cc; red enamel hydrant finish

bronze.source: C83600 leaded red brass/bronze 8.83 g/cc (AWWA C502 operating-nut material)

pine.source: USDA Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-190 Table 5-3a: southern pine ~0.51 specific gravity at 12% MC

oak.source: USDA Wood Handbook: red oak ~0.63-0.75 g/cc at 12% MC

robot-cast-alu.source: effective density (LLF-74): cast-aluminium robot housings with gearboxes inside, modelled solid. 190 kg arm (evsint.com EV10-1450 sheet) minus ~25 kg servos = 164.5 kg over 0.0868 m^3 of modelled castings

robot-cast-orange.source: same effective casting density as robot-cast-alu; generic industrial orange paint (no brand colour match)

servo-motor-black.source: effective density (LLF-74): ~25 kg of AC servo motors (typical 1-3 kW frame ~6-10 kg each) over 0.00422 m^3 modelled motor envelopes

safety-yellow-steel.source: AISI 1018 7.87 g/cc, safety-yellow powder coat (machine-guard posts, ISO 3864 signal yellow)

powder-black-steel.source: AISI 1018 7.87 g/cc, black powder-coated guard panels

letter-foam.source: ASTM C578 Type XI expanded polystyrene, 0.70 pcf = 11.2 kg/m^3 (the light EPS of foam toy letters). Typed letters use it at runtime (src/core/glyphs.js DENSITY.foam); spelled words use Type VIII 18.4 kg/m^3.

ductile-iron-blue.source: ASTM A536 ductile iron 7.1 g/cc; AWWA C550-style blue waterworks coating

steel-zinc-8.8.source: ISO 898-1 class 8.8 carbon steel 7.85 g/cc, zinc plated

carbon-steel-pipe.source: EN 10255 / ISO 65 medium-series carbon steel tube 7.85 g/cc, painted grey-blue
